notes: Company background: adtech DSP focusing on sub-50ms bidding loop integrations; heavy real-time personalization layer that runs model inference inline with bid requests.

Primary problem: current vendor has variable latency at peak (p95 180-220ms) and rising per-request token cost. Need predictable sub-60ms p95 and unit-cost reduction for high QPS (10k-50k qps bursts).

Workload profile: short-context reranking + light personalization prompts (avg prompt tokens 30-60, gen tokens 5-20). Mix of cold-first-request and high locality sessions. 70% reranking, 20% personalization features, 10% dev/debug chat endpoints.
Perf targets: p50 < 12ms, p95 < 60ms for 1-4 token generation paths; sustained throughput target 25k qps for reranks with tail latency SLOs, burst to 60k qps for <5s windows.
Cost sensitivity: target <$0.0008 per rerank call at production scale; interested in batching and quantized model variants to reduce token cost per op.

Model preference: leaning to quantized Llama-2/Redwood-verified 7B variant for a good accuracy/latency tradeoff. Also evaluating trimmed transformer variants. Wants automatic fallback to FP16 13B for complex signals if quality degrades.
Routing/fallback needs: region-aware routing (NA primary, EU fallback), model-variant fallback when Dedicated pool exhausted, must guarantee no PII crosses EU boundary (data residency).

Caching/Batching requirements: aggressive prefix & KV caching for repeated user history; sub-batch windowing strategy (max 8ms wait) acceptable; need SDK hooks to annotate cache keys with session metadata.

Quantization concerns: internal ML infra wants to run 4-bit quantized kernels but requires accuracy regression testing and a toolchain to validate LLM logits drift. Asking for Redwood Optimize suggestions + quantized perf profiles.
Observability asks: token-level cost breakdown per route, per-model p50/p95/p99, exported traces for internal APM (Datadog). Want alerting on quality regressions tied to eval prompt sets.

POC plan: three-day POC in Dedicated sandbox: day 1 baseline w/ hosted/standard model, day 2 quantized model + prefix caching, day 3 load bursts and routing failover. Redwood to provide benchmark harness + sample scripts (k6/proxy) and perf dashboard snapshots.
Quotes/snippets: 'We can't trade accuracy for latency without measurable regressions — need A/B test harness.'; 'Cost per rerank is the single metric our finance team will watch.'
Docs/Artifacts: POC harness repo (drive link), sample prompt set (1000 rerank pairs), baseline p95 traces attached in drive.
Commercial: Interested in 12-month Dedicated commit if POC shows p95 <60ms and unit cost targets hit. Prefers pricing with stepped discounts for sustained burst credits.
Internal stakeholders: CTO (Rajesh Patel) pushing for private VPC option later; CISO (Elena Soto) owns compliance sign-off; ML lead (Priya Anand) responsible for quantization QA.

Open questions for Redwood: exact kernel/quantization profiles supported per GPU type, real vs synthetic latency under cold-KV, length of prefix cache TTLs, fallbacks for model served out-of-region, details on SLA credits and uptime guarantees.
